description:
POST /api/fuel (apps/api/src/routes/fuel.ts:87-100) never accepts a timestamp; loggedAt defaults to now (schema/tracker.ts:168). Food logged the next morning lands on the wrong day, and there is no way to move it.

Accept an optional loggedAt on POST and PATCH, validated to be within a sane window (not future, not more than ~30 days back), and resolve "which day" through the existing local-date helpers (apps/api/src/day.ts) rather than the server zone — ISS-005 is exactly this bug in its earlier form.

UI: a day stepper at the top of the Fuel panel, "< Yesterday | Today >", which switches GET /api/fuel/today to a dated variant and stamps new entries with that day. Pairs with T-015 (back-date a session) — same idea, other domain.

FUEL PAGE (2026-09-26): the stepper sits in the Fuel page header (‹ Sat · Sep 26 ›, "next" disabled on today). The Log food sheet's "When" row (T-055) is how an entry gets retimed. Do this after T-051. PATCH already exists since T-046, so this adds loggedAt to it. Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/CD3dbZS6upyEbpCcv25c2g (Main header, Log "When").
title: Back-date fuel: log and retime an entry on a day other than today
